datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators at sub-national administrative units in Zambia at quarterly intervals (January, April, July, October 2015). Data represent medium-term projection scenarios and are stored as georeferenced polygon features with associated IPC phase values, enabling spatial analysis of food insecurity severity and extent.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification spatial data across Zambia on a regular schedule, assigning acute food insecurity phase scores to administrative units under current and projected scenarios.
